summary: Reviewed this page against current main; no factual edits were needed. `rabbitmq_transport_mode`, `validate_rabbitmq_endpoint` and `build_rabbitmq_parameters` support its TLS-by-default and verification claims; Compact Compose explicitly configures its local broker mode for `rabbitmq-fs:5672`. `self_mint_bootstrap_link` and `_sync_bootstrap_token_state` support the setup-link conditions, 15-minute expiry and restart guidance; `compact_container_cli.main` supports the packaged CLI limitations; `/health/ready` and `BootstrapPage` support the readiness and token-handling instructions. The page qualifies Elestio template, interface and image availability as unverified by this review and labels the September 2026 acceptance as historical. Main-source behavior does not establish that a corresponding image release was published.
